display_title: The Most Effective Way to Use Brainwashing Magic
description:
Lately, Lucy has been having erotic dreams every night. What's more, they are dreams where Evan, the noble hero she travels with, appears as a terrible pervert and takes her roughly. 

“Lucy, spread your legs.” 

“Yes...” 

Throughout their long journey, Evan had never once harassed or groped her, always remaining pure and kind. Thus, Lucy believed that his crude demands in her dreams were merely the result of her own unconscious, dark desires. So, rather than resenting the Evan in her dreams, Lucy quietly complied.
